title: Manara enrolment QR payload
description: Encoded in the QR code that manara_home shows when enrolling a device. Holds only what the app needs to start enrolment. It must never hold a certificate, private key, HA token or password. See ADR 0005 and ADR 0006.

site_id.description: Stable site slug; also the subdomain in ha.<site_id>.manara.co.in.

site_name.description: Display name shown in the app during enrolment.

ha_url.description: Remote HA URL behind the site's Cloudflare Tunnel; requires mTLS.

ha_local_url.description: Optional LAN URL for HA at the site.

enrol_url.description: Where the app posts its CSR and one-time code. TODO(verify): LAN address or an mTLS-exempt hostname, because the device has no client certificate yet.

device_profile.description: Reference to a device profile (device-profile.v1). The app fetches the full profile after enrolment.

one_time_code.description: Single-use enrolment code, valid until expires_at. TODO(verify): length and alphabet; 16 base32 characters is assumed here.

expires_at.description: TODO(verify): default lifetime; 10 minutes is assumed.
